turns.narration:
“Finished and checked,” the bartender agrees. He counts two silver onto the bar and hands over the promised vegetables. “That squares the crate work. The loft’s yours tonight—it’s secure.”

He leaves the mug beside the bucket of cold, filthy dishwater. “And yes, there’s cellar sorting tomorrow, if you’re interested. We’ll settle the terms before you start.”

Up in the loft, you settle in for the night. Eight hours of rest leave you stronger, though not fully recovered.

**Long rest complete:** HP **10/12**. One travel ration used; **2 remain**. The vegetables are stored in your pack.
